What makes a business directory worth trusting?

The case for sources, corrections and transparent selection.

BY CARIBBEAN BUSINESS ATLAS · COMMENTARY & COMPANY RESEARCH

A useful directory is not simply a catalogue of names. Readers need accurate locations, clear services, working official links and the ability to recognize outdated details.

A business's own claims can provide valuable product information, but they are not the same as third-party verification. Good profiles show where their information came from.

Business selection, commercial promotion, editorial features and rankings must be distinguishable. Correctable, sourced information builds longer-term value than anonymous praise.
